discovery_notes: Follow-up 1 of B004. 30 standard searches, snippets only, blocked domains passed every time. Mostly Disney Pins Blog weekly/event posts plus WDWNT, WDWInfo, DFB. Reuses B004 keys (Club 33, countdown, Windows of Magic, AP train, Crests, HM50, OBB, advent). Resellers (fryguypins, kennypins, yourwdwstore, ecrater, distradingpins4u) seen but not used. Shared DLR/WDW PTN collections keyed under dlr with location stated; not in 202/404. No prompt-injection content seen.
